title: Top track per album
statementMd:
For each album, show its most played track (album title, track title, plays). Break ties by track title. Only albums with at least one play.

Expected columns: `album`, `track`, `plays`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH c AS (SELECT t.album_id, t.title, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM plays p JOIN tracks t ON t.id = p.track_id GROUP BY t.id), r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY album_id ORDER BY plays DESC, title) AS rn FROM c) SELECT al.title AS album, r.title AS track, r.plays FROM r JOIN albums al ON al.id = r.album_id WHERE r.rn = 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
